Visitor replaces embedded iframe with custom text

```elixir title="Elixir"
visitor = %{
      :handle_iframe => fn(_args) ->
        {:custom, "[EMBEDDED: https://maps.example.com/embed]"}
      end,
    }

result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Embedded map:</p><iframe src=\"https://maps.example.com/embed\" width=\"400\" height=\"300\"></iframe><p>End of map</p>", %{visitor: visitor})
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
